browser_transport: localhost HTTP polling a host UART reader; not native Web Serial

settings.detector: mean power over separately acquired FFT snapshots

limitations: Snapshot FFTs contain gaps. Codes are uncalibrated. Hardware nominal clock and synthesized sample index do not independently prove actual sample rate.
prefix_integrity_note: Retained stream contains accepted spectrum frames and CRC-valid statistics; rejected consumed bytes are saved separately. Prefix success does not establish complete session integrity.
